## Deviations applied

- **BEN 300** — DEV-D1: GB300 NVL72 racks are drawn 600 x 1068 (NVIDIA MGX / Supermicro / Cisco datasheet). The Vertiv SmartIT enclosure is 1,200 deep with its rear extension: W 2200 - 200 plenum - 1,200 = 800 mm aisle, below the 900 mm egress, so it is not used in a 2.2 m module.
- **BEN 700** — DEV-D1: GB300 NVL72 racks are drawn 600 x 1068 (NVIDIA MGX / Supermicro / Cisco datasheet). The Vertiv SmartIT enclosure is 1,200 deep with its rear extension: W 2200 - 200 plenum - 1,200 = 800 mm aisle, below the 900 mm egress, so it is not used in a 2.2 m module.
- **BEN 2000** — DEV-K1: pad-mount transformer footprint 2100 x 2100 mm and mass 4300 kg are estimates (estimate: typical three-phase 1,000 kVA dead-front pad-mount footprint and mass, not read from a datasheet); the yard keeps 1500 mm behind and 3000 mm in front, so a larger unit fits by moving the service lane.
- **BEN 2000** — Every module: DEV-D1: GB300 NVL72 racks are drawn 600 x 1068 (NVIDIA MGX / Supermicro / Cisco datasheet). The Vertiv SmartIT enclosure is 1,200 deep with its rear extension: W 2200 - 200 plenum - 1,200 = 800 mm aisle, below the 900 mm egress, so it is not used in a 2.2 m module.
